baseline.name: weekly_all
baseline.sql:
SELECT
            w."weekNumber",
            w."startDate",
            w."endDate",
            wts."memberId",
            lm."teamName",
            wts."pointsAwarded",
            wts."pointDifferential",
            wts.rank
            FROM "WeeklyTeamScore" wts
            JOIN "Week" w
            ON w.id = wts."weekId"
            JOIN "LeagueMember" lm
            ON lm.id = wts."memberId"
            WHERE wts."leagueId" = :leagueId
            AND w."weekNumber" IN (:weekNumbers_1, :weekNumbers_2, :weekNumbers_3, :weekNumbers_4, :weekNumbers_5, :weekNumbers_6, :weekNumbers_7, :weekNumbers_8, :weekNumbers_9, :weekNumbers_10, :weekNumbers_11, :weekNumbers_12)
            ORDER BY w."weekNumber" ASC, wts.rank ASC;

baseline.name: weekly_all
baseline.sql:
SELECT
            w."weekNumber",
            w."startDate",
            w."endDate",
            wts."memberId",
            lm."teamName",
            wts."pointsAwarded",
            wts."pointDifferential",
            wts.rank
            FROM "WeeklyTeamScore" wts
            JOIN "Week" w
            ON w.id = wts."weekId"
            JOIN "LeagueMember" lm
            ON lm.id = wts."memberId"
            WHERE wts."leagueId" = :leagueId
            AND w."weekNumber" IN (:weekNumbers_1, :weekNumbers_2, :weekNumbers_3, :weekNumbers_4, :weekNumbers_5, :weekNumbers_6, :weekNumbers_7, :weekNumbers_8, :weekNumbers_9, :weekNumbers_10, :weekNumbers_11, :weekNumbers_12)
